card.name: Inside brand drug and gene names
card.fires_on: Partway through newly coined brand names or gene names, usually written in capitals, in label warnings and dosing text. Also fires on a stray period after a page number in one web passage.

modes.label: Brand names in capitals
modes.description: Middle piece of an uppercase brand name, often after words like Withhold, Discontinue, or Interrupt.
modes.example: Discontinue P<<IF>>ELTRO immediately if signs or symptoms

modes.label: Gene or generic name pieces
modes.description: Middle piece of a gene symbol or a generic antibody name.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are code-related fragments and the suppressed ones are odd pieces, so there is no clear link to the output.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of unfamiliar, newly invented drug or gene names.
